messages.text: Core implementation is in place. I’m compiling the wrapper and running side-by-side probes for errors, AES, ZipCrypto, masks, and dictionaries.

commands.commandLine:
powershell.exe -Command "bash ./compile.sh; @'
import subprocess,pathlib,json,re
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); exe=str(root/'executable.cmd'); z2=str((root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip').resolve()); multi=str((root/'rust-reference/test-files/multi-file-with-dir.zip').resolve()); dic=str((root/'rust-reference/test-files/generated-passwords-lowercase.txt').resolve())
cases=[[],['--version'],['-h'],['-i','missing.zip'],['-i',z2,'-w','0'],['-i',z2,'-w','1','-c','l','--minPasswordLen','1','--maxPasswordLen','2'],['-i',z2,'-w','1','-c','l','--minPasswordLen','1','--maxPasswordLen','1'],['-i',z2,'-w','1','-p',dic],['-i',z2,'-w','1','--mask','a?l'],['-i',multi,'-w','1','-p',dic],['-i',z2,'--mask','?z'],['-i',z2,'-1','ab']]
for a in cases:
 rr=subprocess.run([ref,*a],capture_output=True)
 pp=subprocess.run([exe,*a],capture_output=True)
 def norm(x): return re.sub(rb'Time elapsed: .*\\n',b'Time elapsed: <TIME>\\n',x)
 ok=(rr.returncode==pp.returncode and norm(rr.stdout)==norm(pp.stdout) and rr.stderr==pp.stderr)
 print(('OK ' if ok else 'BAD'),json.dumps(a),rr.returncode,pp.returncode)
 if not ok:
  print('REFOUT',repr(rr.stdout));print('PORTOUT',repr(pp.stdout));print('REFERR',repr(rr.stderr));print('PORTERR',repr(pp.stderr))
'@ | python -"
